# opnsense_nginx_sni_hostname_map (Data Source)

nginx SNI upstream maps (**Services ▸ Nginx ▸ Configuration ▸ Streams ▸ SNI Based Routing**, plugin `os-nginx`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the map.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Name of the map.
- `entries` (Attributes List) Host names and the upstreams they go to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Read-Only:

- `hostname` (String) Host name sent by the client.
- `upstream` (String) UUID of the upstream.
